title: Add error logging to pack install rollback
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**File**: `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go:260-273`

**Issue**: All four rollback operations silently discard errors (`_ = restoreConfigOverlay(...)`, etc.). If rollback fails, the operator gets zero feedback and the system is left in an inconsistent state.

**Fix**: Log each rollback error with `slog.Warn` so operators can diagnose partial failures. Example: `if err := restoreConfigOverlay(...); err != nil { slog.Warn("rollback: failed to restore config overlay", "error", err) }`
definitionOfDone: All four rollback error paths log warnings via slog.Warn
Log messages include the operation name and error detail

implementationPlan.description: Replace the 4 blank-identifier error discards in the `rollback` closure (lines 262, 265, 268, 271) with `if err := ...; err != nil { slog.Warn("pack install rollback: <operation> failed", "error", err, "index", i) }` for each of the four operations: restoreConfigOverlay, restorePolicyOverlay, rollbackWorkflow, rollbackSchema.
Ensure `log/slog` is in the import block (likely already imported elsewhere in the file).
Run existing tests with `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
